view.name: Conversion result
view.description: After pasting rich text, the converter shows a 'Converted pasted.md' header with Copy Markdown / Download .md / Convert another file actions and side-by-side Markdown source and rendered preview panels.

regions.label: Logo badge 'w2m' plus serif wordmark 'Word to Markdown'
Eyebrow 'FREE · OPEN SOURCE · 100% IN YOUR BROWSER', mixed-type H1, subtitle, .docx → .md chips, 'Converting docs since 2014'
'Converted pasted.md' heading with Copy Markdown (primary), Download .md and Convert another file buttons
Two side-by-side bordered panels: MARKDOWN (monospace source) and PREVIEW (rendered output); each scrolls internally
Outlined aside 'Nice — one more doc out of Word…' with 'See Open & Async →' link
Language nav (20 languages, globe icon), site links row, mono tagline 'Converted in your browser · nothing is uploaded'

evidence.note: Raw Markdown source pane beside rendered preview pane of the same converted document; equal fixed widths, no draggable divider, each scrolls independently at 900px

patterns.rationale: Capture is in the post-conversion result state; the drop zone ('Drop your .docx here or click to choose a file') only appears on the live page after clicking 'Convert another file', so the upload entry point itself is not in the captured screenshot.

evidence.note: Returns to the dropzone (verified live): 'Drop your .docx here', 'Up to 20 MB · Converted on this device'
Filename suggests pasted input was also accepted

evidence.quote: Nice — one more doc out of Word and into the open.
evidence.note: Promotional aside for a book, not a condition needing attention
'Conversion complete. Your Markdown is ready.' exists only as a screen-reader status, no visible toast
Markdown pane is read-only monospace output, not an editor

structure.layout: single centered column: minimal header with logo, centered hero with eyebrow/h1/subtitle/.docx→.md glyph, then a converter section in result state (filename heading, action button row, two side-by-side fixed-height scrolling panels: raw Markdown and rendered Preview), a promo aside, and a centered footer with language nav and site links

aesthetics.typography: Fraunces (serif, italic 'Word' in H1, wordmark, section H2s like 'Converted', preview headings); JetBrains Mono (eyebrow, 'Markdown' half of H1, file chips, filename, Markdown pane, footer tagline); Hanken Grotesk (body, subtitle, buttons, preview text, footer links)
aesthetics.typeScale: Large display H1 72px mixing serif italic and monospace; subtitle 20px; H2 18px/500 serif; body/buttons 14px (600 for primary); eyebrow and labels 11-13px letter-spaced mono uppercase

notes: Captured in the post-conversion state (the page converted itself as 'pasted.md'), so the upload dropzone, how-it-works 3-step strip and dark book promo card seen on the live page after 'Convert another file' are not in the capture. Distinctive character: warm off-white paper background with a faint dot-grid texture at top, chartreuse (#d0d820) primary button and pale-chartreuse '.md' chip contrasting olive (#646a00) mono eyebrow text; H1 typographically mixes Fraunces italic 'Word', muted 'to', and JetBrains Mono 'Markdown' to literally depict the conversion. Panels have small uppercase mono headers with colored status dots (chartreuse for Markdown, slate for Preview). Links underlined with chartreuse underline. Footer lists 20 language links centered with a globe icon.
